tagline: A youth-led society publishing literature and journalism, free for everyone.
about:
LJS is an independent literary platform started by two stubborn teenagers. We love being loud, bold, and full of whimsy in everything we do. At LJS, our aim is to create a platform that is accessible to all and allows creative people to share their work with an audience that cares about it.

Join us as we turn your brainrot feeds into an introspective oasis.

teamIntro.writers: The minds who help create every single issue of The Youth Gazette, with their unique perspectives and beautiful words.
teamIntro.designers: The tiny but mighty design team of LJS, who are some of the coolest people you will find. Their ability to perfectly encapsulate a theme into visuals is their greatest quality.
